How it works

1

Connect & Send Details

Click 'Start on WhatsApp', tell us your project requirements, or share your raw footage link (Google Drive, WeTransfer, or Dropbox).

2

Our dedicated editors transform your footage with cinematic color grading, sound design, and custom captions within 24–48 hours.

3

Review & Final HD Delivery

Review your draft directly on WhatsApp. We provide free revisions until you're 100% satisfied, then deliver your final HD master file!

What The FAQ?

How does your pricing work?
You can order one video at a time or a discounted package of videos. Our standard pricing for long-form video editing is as low as $278 per video when you purchase a package of 8 videos. Short-form videos start at $80 in a package of 30. Think of packages as your inventory of videos.

Our pricing is also based on the amount of raw footage you submit per order. Standard pricing includes up to 60 minutes and 20 GB of raw footage for long-form videos. If your raw footage is longer there is an additional fee.

Plus, you can purchase add-ons such as thumbnails or vertical reformats for short-form platforms when you submit a new video order for $43 per thumbnail or vertical reformat.

We also offer YouTube channel management. This means we run and grow your channel for you — from strategy advice to managing video uploads and SEO to providing YouTube analytics reports. Our channel management services are designed to work together with our video editing services as the ultimate all-in-one solution for creators and businesses and are priced as a separate subscription for as low as $1,266 per month.
What types of videos do you edit?
Pretty much any type of video you can think of! This includes advertisements, beauty & fashion, compilations, cooking, fitness, haul and product reviews, interviews, lifestyle content, online courses, real estate tours, podcasts, talking heads, trainings, travel, tutorials, vlogs, video essays… just to name a few.

Currently, we DO NOT edit: wedding videos or 2D or 3D animations. We do not provide voiceover services but we CAN edit your voiceover videos.
How do I share my footage?
When you submit a new video order you can upload your raw footage directly to our our client portal or a share a link to your own cloud storage. our client portal is the software we built from scratch to make submitting and tracking your videos fast and easy.
What video editing software do you use?
Our professional video editors use Premiere Pro and After Effects. We built our our client portal from scratch to make submitting your orders, sharing your footage, communicating with your team, and tracking your orders fast and easy.
Will I have the same video editor for every order?
You bet! You have the same dedicated video manager, video editor, thumbnail artist (if you order thumbnails), and YouTube channel manager (if you sign up for YouTube Channel Management) for every video.
Do I have full ownership of the videos?
Yes, of course! You maintain full rights and ownership of all videos and deliverables.
